items.rules: Counting rules: TC1 holds if, on 11 Nov 2026, the October 2025 measures (MOFCOM announcements Nos. 61 and 62 of 2025 and related‡) are not in force for exports to the US, by extension, replacement or withdrawal. items.rules: Counting rules: "daily news programming" = new news content published or broadcast on at least five days a week in the month of December 2027, by the service's own staff or contractors. OTF receipt is taken from OTF's own statements, court filings or USAGM reports; if no source states it by the check date, (c) is scored as holding.
